exposure: trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
outcome: Combined maternal and neonatal adverse outcomes
cohort: 5,447 women who had undergone one previous cesarean section and attempted TOLAC carrying a singleton fetus in vertex presentation
finding: Grandmultiparity (parity of 5 or more) is not associated with an increased risk of uterine rupture during TOLAC.
mod_finding: Operative delivery rate differed significantly between the three parity groups; 25.1%, 6.2%, and 3.6%, for groups 1, 2, and 3, respectively.
